Onbording.title: Welcome to Watch and Learn!
Onbording.descriptionInterface: This determines the language of your interface; what you see on the screen. We recommend choosing English, even if your level is beginner. However, you can skip this step and select your preference later using the interface language switch wich will be available fro you in your profile.
Onbording.discriptionStudy: This determines the language used for explanations and translations. For example, if you want to see the meaning of a word or phrase, it will be translated into language you will choose. Since this is a Ukrainian product, the interface language is currently available in English or Ukrainian only.

Lessons.title: Lessons
Lessons.levelLowDesc: The script appears line by line with some missing words. Instead of the missing words, you will see empty slots. Below each line, you will find possible word options. Your task is to drag and drop the correct word into the correct slot.
Lessons.levelMediumDesc: You need to type the missing word into the blank input field.
Lessons.levelHighDesc: In this version, the script is not visible. You will only see punctuation as a hint. You will see an input field where you need to type the script word by word.
Lessons.step1: Read the lesson description first to understand the context.
Lessons.step2: Start with the Low difficulty level. If it feels too easy, move one level up. If you struggle to find the correct word, try again or choose an easier video.
Lessons.step3: Under the video, you will find the lesson key. We recommend trying the exercise before looking at the answer. If you do not understand what a character is saying, try listening several times before checking the answer.
Lessons.step4: If you complete the lesson successfully, by the end you should be able to read the text out loud at the same time as the characters. This technique is called shadowing.
Lessons.noteDesc: The translations in the lesson key are not always exact. We prioritize decoding the idea, feeling, or meaning expressed in English over providing a word-for-word translation.
